50547776.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to 8His-tagged Pin1 (45-163) PPIase domain by surface plasmon resonance spectroscopy

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T100 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. The 8His-tagged Pin1 (45-163) PPIase domain was immobilized on the chip via Ni-NTA capture. Compounds were dissolved in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 µM at a flow rate of 30 µL/min. Association and dissociation phases were 180 s and 300 s, respectively. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine-HCl, pH 2.0. Data were analyzed using Biacore T100 evaluation software. The binding affinity (KD) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20)
